gecko.visible_surface_material: Painted aluminum beverage can with a smooth, glossy metallic finish
gecko.visible_surface_condition: Smooth, clean, and nonporous cylindrical sidewall
evidence_used: Visual appearance of a standard 355ml aluminum beverage can with a smooth cylindrical body
Clean and nonporous painted metallic surface ideal for directional dry adhesives
Gecko gripper embodiment description specifying suitability for smooth, clean, nonporous surfaces
gecko.calculation_summary: Estimated normal force scaled from nominal object weight (~0.36 kg or ~3.5 N gravitational force) divided by two contact pads, then reduced by effective directional dry adhesion multipliers: F_normal = (W / 2) / mu_effective approx (3.5 / 2) / 1.5 approx 1.2 N
assumptions_and_uncertainty: Exact object mass is unmeasured and estimated visually based on standard beverage can size
Surface is assumed free of moisture, condensation, or oils that degrade gecko adhesion
Compliant fin-ray structure achieves adequate pre-load seating against the curved cylindrical sidewall
gecko.reasoning_trace: The object is a smooth aluminum can with clean sidewalls, representing an ideal substrate for a gecko-inspired dry adhesive pad. The gecko pad can leverage high directional shear-to-normal adhesion ratios, requiring minimal normal pre-load force (approx 1.2 N) to securely establish contact and lift the object without crushing it.

silicone.visible_surface_material: Painted aluminum beverage can with a smooth, glossy metallic finish
silicone.visible_surface_condition: Smooth, clean, and nonporous cylindrical sidewall
evidence_used: Visual appearance of a standard 355ml aluminum beverage can
Smooth painted aluminum cylinder requiring frictional holding capacity
Silicone gripper embodiment description specifying reliance on friction and viscoelastic interaction
silicone.calculation_summary: Estimated normal force based on friction requirement to lift object weight (~3.5 N) with an estimated coefficient of friction ~0.7 between silicone and painted aluminum: F_normal = (W / 2) / mu = (3.5 / 2) / 0.7 approx 2.5 N
assumptions_and_uncertainty: Exact object mass is unmeasured and estimated visually
Coefficient of friction between silicone and the painted aluminum surface is assumed around 0.7
No authoritative slip tests or friction measurements were supplied
silicone.reasoning_trace: The silicone gripper relies on pure frictional and viscoelastic contact rather than directional dry adhesion. To lift the approximately 3.5 N can against gravity using two opposing friction pads, a higher normal force of 2.5 N is required to prevent slip, given typical rubber-to-metal friction coefficients.

comparison_evidence: Smooth, nonporous, clean painted aluminum surface of the beverage can
Gecko embodiment advantage on clean, smooth, rigid containers requiring lower normal pre-load forces
Silicone gripper requirement for higher normal force due to lower friction coefficient and lack of directional dry-adhesion enhancement
recommendation_summary: The gecko gripper is recommended because the aluminum beverage can provides a clean, smooth, and nonporous surface that is exceptionally well-suited for mushroom-cap dry adhesives. This allows the gecko gripper to achieve secure grasping at a lower normal force (1.2 N) compared to the high-friction silicone pad (2.5 N), minimizing potential deformation or crushing of thin-walled containers.
